title: Agy Gemini Flash Reflection
desc: Reflection guidelines and lessons for Agy Gemini Flash sessions.
steps: PURPOSE: Document failures and lessons learned during Agy Gemini Flash sessions to improve compliance and harness reliability.

GIT PINSET COMMIT DISCIPLINE: Never use git add -A or git reset in shared workspaces, as it can stage or disrupt work being done by other concurrent agents or families. Always commit explicitly targeted files (e.g. git commit tools/wkharness-agy-main.ps1).

AGY HARNESS CACHING RULES: permissions.allow array in settings.json must be reset to size 1 containing only the current tool call. Always re-read the settings file fresh every time before modifying it using .NET File API to ensure real-time consistency.
AUTO-RECOVERY OF CONFIG.JSON: config.json in ~/.gemini/config/config.json must be checked and auto-recovered with UTF-8 No BOM at startup to prevent infinite approval popup loops.
